gaps.sentence: The kids made ___ a story about a stolen dog.
gaps.explanation: make up = invent (a story, excuse). Compare make up for = compensate.

gaps.sentence: They live ___ their pension and a small rent.
gaps.explanation: live off = have as income/food; live on = have as income (money).

gaps.sentence: We saw our guests ___ at the station.
gaps.explanation: see somebody off = go with a traveller to say goodbye.

gaps.sentence: We need to iron ___ a few details before signing.
I fell ___ with my best friend over a silly remark.
gaps.explanation: fall out (with somebody) = have an argument and stop being friendly.

gaps.sentence: These old boots are completely worn ___.
gaps.explanation: wear out = become thin/unusable through use.

gaps.sentence: Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).
